title: Easy Bok Choy Stir Fry with Oyster Sauce - Vicky Pham
ldName: Easy Bok Choy Stir Fry with Oyster Sauce
ldKeywords: bok choy recipe, bok choy recipe with oyster sauce, easy bok choy recipe, asian bok choy recipe, asian-style bok choy recipe, oyster sauce recipe, asian stir fry recipe, easy asian stir fry recipe, easy vegetarian stir fry recipe, bok choy, stir fry recipe with bok choy, pak choi, pak choi recipe, pok choi recipe, pok choi, Vietnamese bok choy recipe, bok choy recipe stir fry, pok choy, pak choy, pok choy recipe, pok choy recipe, bok choy onion recipe, bok choy garlic recipe, bok choy recipe with dark sauce, boy choy recipe with brown sauce
ldIngredientsRaw: ½ cup water (room temperature or cold)
ldInstructionsRaw: Cut the bok choy in half lengthwise. Halve it again if it’s too big. Submerge the bok choy in water to clean then rinse thoroughly. Peel the onion and cut it into medium wedges.
In a small bowl, whisk together the water, oyster sauce, and tapioca starch until smooth.

Fill a tall pan or wok with plenty of water (about 1-½ quarts) and bring it to a rolling boil. Add bok choy and blanch for 3 minutes, tossing for even cooking. Remove the bok choy from the water and set aside.
Drain the pan and wipe dry. Add oil and heat on medium-high. Add the onions and stir-fry them until lightly charred on the outside (about 3 minutes).

Give the sauce mixture a stir in case the tapioca starch has settled. Pour the sauce into the pan. It should thicken almost immediately. Add the blanched bok choy and toss to combine with the sauce. There’s no need to cook it any further. Serve it with rice or noodles for a complete meal.
